2022-07-05 02:15:30.20 spid58      The availability replica for availability group 'AG_Sales' on this instance of SQL Server cannot become the primary replica. One or more databases are not synchronized or have not joined the availability group, or the WSFC cluster was started in Force Quorum mode. If the cluster was started in Force Quorum mode or the availability replica uses the asynchronous-commit mode, you can use the failover with data loss option to bring the availability replica online. Otherwise, you must wait until the databases are synchronized or joined, and then retry the failover command.
